Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass this on. I'm not going to take it to Ruth or any channel, and I won't look into Bluefin unless you ask me to.

If you think Ruth should know, the best route is probably a conversation with her, or a word with Mateo about who briefs her. I can help you draft a short note to Ruth from you, but I won't send anything on your behalf unless you tell me to.
